mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event (event_se, category_id, author_id, title, content, is_notice) VALUES ('ANN', #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, category_id, title, content, views, created_at, like_count FROM event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND event_se = 'ANN' LIMIT 1
SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_se = 'ANN' AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND event_id < #{eventId} ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_se = 'ANN' AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND event_id > #{eventId} ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE event SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND like_count > 0
